mapper.insert: insert into replacement_records (house_id, rabbit_id, original_type, replacement_date, expected_mature_date, is_mature_notified, mature_notify_date, remark, create_by, update_by) values (#{houseId}, #{rabbitId}, #{originalType}, #{replacementDate}, #{expectedMatureDate}, #{isMatureNotified}, #{matureNotifyDate}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.update: update replacement_records set is_mature_notified = true, mature_notify_date = now(), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and is_mature_notified = false and expected_mature_date <= #{today}
update replacement_records set is_mature_notified = true, mature_notify_date = #{notifyDate}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and house_id = #{houseId}
